about: One project grown over many fresh chats, each a feature request on the code the earlier ones left. Measures whether the harness keeps a growing codebase coherent (~1K -> 3K -> 10K lines): time, tool calls, size, tests, and regressions (tests that passed after an earlier session and fail now). {ws} is the project folder.

sessions.request: Build a small inventory app for a community tool-lending workshop in {ws}: Python 3 standard library only, SQLite storage, an HTTP JSON API (http.server) and a terminal client that talks to it. Members, tools (name, category, condition), and loans (who has what, since when). Write docs/DESIGN.md with the API routes and CLI commands, and tests (pytest) that start the real server on a free port.

In the workshop app in {ws}: add due dates to loans (default 14 days), an 'overdue' listing in the API and the CLI, and the ability to renew a loan once. Keep docs/DESIGN.md and the tests up to date; all existing tests must keep passing.
In the workshop app in {ws}: add reservations — a member can reserve a tool that is out; when it is returned it is held for the first reserver for 2 days. API + CLI + tests; update docs/DESIGN.md.

In the workshop app in {ws}: add member roles (member, volunteer, admin). Only volunteers and admins can check tools out and in; only admins can add or retire tools. Use an API token per member (header). Update the client, the docs and the tests.

In the workshop app in {ws}: add maintenance tracking — log repairs and inspections per tool, flag tools due for inspection (every 90 days or 20 loans), and block lending a tool that is out for repair. API + CLI + tests + docs.
In the workshop app in {ws}: add CSV import and export for members and tools, with validation errors reported per row (line number + reason). API + CLI + tests + docs.

In the workshop app in {ws}: add usage statistics — most borrowed tools, busiest members, average loan length, per month and per category, as API endpoints and a CLI 'stats' command with a plain-text table. Tests + docs.

In the workshop app in {ws}: add late fees — a configurable fee per overdue day with a cap, a member balance, payments, and a rule that members owing more than a limit cannot borrow. Keep money exact (integer cents). API + CLI + tests + docs.

In the workshop app in {ws}: add a minimal web page served by the same server (static HTML + vanilla JS) that lists tools with their status and lets a volunteer check a tool out or in using the existing API. Add tests for the API calls the page uses; update docs.

In the workshop app in {ws}: add an audit log — every change (loans, returns, edits, payments, role changes) is recorded with who, what and when; an admin can query it by member, tool or date range via API and CLI. Tests + docs.

In the workshop app in {ws}: add database migrations — a schema version table and numbered migration steps, so an existing database from any earlier version upgrades in place on start. Add a test that builds an old-schema database and upgrades it. Update docs.

In the workshop app in {ws}: add multi-site support — the workshop has several locations; tools belong to a site, transfers between sites are recorded, and every listing can filter by site. Migrate existing data to a default site. API + CLI + tests + docs.

In the workshop app in {ws}: add notifications — a daily job (CLI command) that produces reminder messages for loans due tomorrow, overdue loans, ready reservations and tools due for inspection, written to an outbox table and viewable via API. Tests + docs.
In the workshop app in {ws}: add a search endpoint and CLI command across tools, members and loans (case-insensitive, partial match, combinable filters, paginated). Tests + docs.

In the workshop app in {ws}: review the whole codebase for duplicated logic and inconsistent error handling between modules; refactor so every API error has the same JSON shape and every CLI command reports errors the same way. Behaviour must not change otherwise: all existing tests must keep passing, and add tests for the error shapes.
